name: Kareen's Christmas
source:
It's late at night and Kareen's been having a hard time sleeping because Bill just won't keep it down! So she decides to deal with it the only way she knows how.

[From [url=https://zuripaigames.itch.io/kareens-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜深人静，卡琳却翻来覆去怎么也睡不着，全怪比尔那家伙吵个不停！于是，她决定用自己唯一擅长的办法来摆平这件事。

[摘自[url=https://zuripaigames.itch.io/kareens-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
